criterion: EvidenceClaim: supporting passage and location resolve in the cited source; population, design and endpoint transcribed correctly (protocol acceptance_criteria.evidence_claim)
Report: every number traces to a committed artifact in the same task
criterion_version: protocol v1 (A0001-StudyProtocol, acceptance_criteria.evidence_claim); TaskMessage T0006 scientific_acceptance_criteria
held_out_data: not_applicable (literature source check; no outcome labels or vault items accessed)
method: Independent re-retrieval, not reusing R1's verification: Europe PMC REST search (EXT_ID:<pmid> AND SRC:MED, resultType=core) for the 13 PubMed-indexed claims; normalised substring match of supporting_passage against abstractText (HTML tags, dashes and whitespace normalised) plus manual reading of every abstract for population, design, endpoint, numbers, follow-up and bibliographic fields (title, DOI, PMCID, journal/volume/issue/pages). A0024 checked against the cited aesnet.org abstract page via WebFetch, and its design paper PMID 32412094 via Europe PMC. A0030 co-publication PMID 42929804 checked. Wu 2019 'US centres' checked from Europe PMC author affiliations. Script: studies/study-001/work/T0006/fetch_check.py; raw records in work/T0006/sources/.

evidence_claims.passage_verbatim: 14/14 (13 Europe PMC abstracts + 1 AES abstract page)
evidence_claims.bibliographic_match: 13/13 PMID records match title and DOI; SLATE AES abstract number, date and authors match
evidence_claims.follow_up_vs_protocol_ge_12mo: meets: A0017-A0024, A0027; to_verify (not in abstract, correctly flagged): A0025, A0028, A0029; partially (median 19 mo, some individuals possibly <12 mo, flagged): A0026; not_applicable: A0030

uncertainty_method: not_applicable (deterministic verification; no statistical estimate). Limitation: R5, like R1, accessed abstracts only (NEJM full text returned 403; Europe PMC fullTextXML returned HTTP 500); full-text-only details (e.g. Wiebe 2001 age criterion, SF definitions and follow-up in A0025/A0028/A0029) remain unverified.

failure_cases.issue: '5 study families' for LITT, but cited claims carry 4 family ids (fam-slate-nct02844465, fam-litt-mtle-us-multicenter-wu2019, fam-emory-slah, fam-litt-pooled-meta-analyses); sentence self-contradictory.

'Range for temporal resection: about 47-77%' includes the paediatric mixed-procedure Dwivedi 77% (A0019) and the all-procedure de Tisi 47% (A0021); the label is not traceable to temporal-resection-specific data.
LITT range stated as 53-58% (section 2) and 55-58% (bottom line); A0023 gives 53.4%.
'15 sources opened' does not trace to any committed artifact.
Envelope consumed_artifact_ids = [A0001] only; the claims A0017-A0030 used for every number are not recorded as consumed.

observations_not_failures: A0017 headline says 'adults' but the abstract states no age criterion (the structured population field correctly says not_reported); R5 could not open the NEJM full text.
A0024: aesnet page states 'Study funded by Medtronic', which resolves R1's funding to_verify; no peer-reviewed SLATE results paper found in R5's Europe PMC search (2024-2026).

R5's Europe PMC search surfaced PMID 41943816 (2026 commentary on a 'LAANTERN' LITT study) and PMID 42425569 (MINE RCT protocol); neither is committed. They may be worth an R1 follow-up for LITT evidence, but this is outside T0006's scope.

Study-family grouping: pooling A0025-A0029 into one family is conservative and sensible. Overlap between the pooled family and the primary series (A0022, A0023) and between A0020 and A0021 is correctly flagged to_verify.
verdict: EvidenceClaims A0017-A0030: passed (14/14). Report A0032: failed (repairable traceability and labelling defects; underlying claims sound).
evidence_level: literature_reported claims verified against source abstracts (abstract-level verification only; not full text)
